description: This file defines the PinnedAppListViewModel class and its nested class PinnedAppListLiveData, responsible for managing and providing a list of user-pinned applications on an Android device. It interacts with SharedPreferences to store and retrieve pinned apps, and performs asynchronous loading of app data based on stored component names.

classes.name: PinnedAppListViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel that provides a list of applications pinned by the user for display on the home screen. It manages a LiveData object that observers can subscribe to for updates.

classes.name: PinnedAppListLiveData
classes.description: A LiveData subclass that asynchronously loads the list of pinned applications from SharedPreferences and queries their information via PackageManager.

methods.name: getPinnedAppList
methods.description: Returns the LiveData object holding the list of pinned applications.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of pinned apps from SharedPreferences, querying each via PackageManager, and updates the LiveData value.
